the supply chain members should consider the fairness indices to make investment decisions, and the revenue sharing contract is the most appropriate contract to achieve coordination.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

a revenue-sharing contract is not the best choice for a sustainable supply chain of fresh products, and an alternative contract, i.e., an incremental quantity discount, may be more suitable for this purpose.

joint investments in a fresh agricultural products supply chains should be considered, but the investment cost sharing and revenue sharing contracts are not sufficient to achieve an efficient joint investment.
